rite.value: CCEO can. 28 §1: a rite is the liturgical, theological, spiritual and disciplinary patrimony… (Ritus est patrimonium liturgicum, theologicum, spirituale et disciplinare)

church_sui_iuris.value: CCEO can. 27: a community of the faithful joined by a hierarchy according to law, recognised as sui iuris by the supreme authority

five_eastern_traditions.value: Alexandrian, Antiochene, Armenian, Chaldean, Constantinopolitan (CCEO can. 28 §2)

ccc_1203_list.value: Latin (principally Roman; also Ambrosian, certain religious orders), Byzantine, Alexandrian or Coptic, Syriac, Armenian, Maronite and Chaldean

meta.count_note: 24 Churches sui iuris = Latin + 23 Eastern. Lists differ at the margins: GCatholic omits Albanian and lists 'Byzantine Church in Kazakhstan and Central Asia'; Ruthenian/Mukachevo/Czech exarchate grouping varies (CNEWA). This file follows the Annuario-derived CNEWA grouping and flags the variants.

access.title: The Roman Missal adapted to the use of the laity (c. 1900)

status_magisterial.value: Art. 1: the liturgical books promulgated by Paul VI and John Paul II 'are the unique expression of the lex orandi of the Roman Rite'.
Art. 2: it is the diocesan bishop's 'exclusive competence to authorize the use of the 1962 Roman Missal in his diocese, according to the guidelines of the Apostolic See'.
Responsa ad dubia of the Congregation for Divine Worship (dated 4 Dec 2021, published 18 Dec 2021) on application.
Rescript (20 Feb 2023, published 21 Feb 2023): dispensations for use in parish churches and for priests ordained after 16 Jul 2021 reserved to the Apostolic See.
Traditionis custodes abrogated the norms of Summorum Pontificum (2007), which had called the 1962 Missal the 'extraordinary expression' of the lex orandi.

status_reported_not_magisterial.value: Reported (Oct 2026): no change to Traditionis custodes under Leo XIV; press reports a letter of Leo XIV to Card. Roche (dated 29 Jun 2026) and an interview remark by Card. Roche. These are reports, not legislative acts.
status_reported_not_magisterial.note: Specific article URLs from the earlier pass should be re-attached before publication; do not quote.

latin_rites_and_uses.terminology_note: Use neutral terms: 'Roman Missal of 1962' / 'pre-conciliar Roman Missal'. Avoid 'Extraordinary Form' as a current legal category (it derives from Summorum Pontificum, abrogated in 2021) and avoid partisan labels.
